objective: Compare the exact convolution and SSM source-cache bytes entering the first speculative call of every GDN layer for c1 and c2. R84 proved native packed c2 is operator-exact when cache contents are equal.

instrumentation.scope: First pure-spec call per (GDN layer, request-count shape, TP process).
payload_per_request: accepted count and selected state column/index
SHA-256 of selected convolution state row
SHA-256 of selected SSM state row
SHA-256 of that request's projected qkvz and ba rows

fixed_workload.sequence: Run cache-c000 alone at c1, then cache-c000 plus index-c001 at c2 in the same fresh server.

decision: For each TP rank, compare c1 request 0 with c2 request 0 by layer. The first projected-input or selected-cache digest mismatch is the new boundary. If every selected input digest matches, investigate integration ordering/lifetime rather than cache production.
promotion_boundary: Diagnostic only. SHA tracing synchronizes device data and invalidates throughput measurement.
